summary_en: Alps Alpine will sell 3 million shares of Nippon Seiki (held entirely) via a ToSTNeT-3 block trade scheduled for September 18, 2026, in connection with the termination of a capital alliance. An investment securities gain of approximately 5 billion yen is expected to be recorded in the second quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice on Placement of Shares in NISE Seiki via ToSTNeT-3 (Off-Hours Block Trade) and Anticipated Recording of Investment Securities Gain (Extraordinary Income)
translation_en_brief:
Alps Alpine announced on September 17, 2026, its decision to sell all 3,000,000 shares of Nippon Seiki via a ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block trade scheduled for September 18, 2026. This sale follows the termination of a capital alliance between the two companies, as announced by Alps Alpine on January 27, 2026. The shares were previously held as a strategic investment, and this sale supports the company's strategy to reduce policy-held securities and improve capital efficiency.

The sale is contingent on the successful completion of Nippon Seiki's own ToSTNeT-3 block purchase. Assuming completion as planned, Alps Alpine expects to record an investment securities gain of approximately 5 billion yen in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (ending March 31, 2027). This amount is a preliminary estimate calculated based on Nippon Seiki's closing price as of September 17, 2026, and anticipated transaction costs; the final gain may vary depending on the actual number of shares sold and execution details.

The company noted that the full impact on fiscal 2027 full-year consolidated earnings forecasts is under review and will be disclosed if revisions to forward guidance are necessary. The transaction is subject to market conditions and the successful execution of Nippon Seiki's share purchase via ToSTNeT-3.
